title: How to Use Dynamic Text in Thrive Apprentice

steps.raw_text: Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice**.
Click the **Design** tab in the left sidebar.
Select the online school design you want to edit.
Click the **Manage Templates** button in the **Template Editor** card.
steps.context: button in the Template Editor card

steps.raw_text: Find the template you want to modify (e.g., **Lesson Template**, **Course Overview Template**, or **Module Template**).
steps.context: Course Overview Template, or Module Template)

steps.raw_text: Click **Edit** to open the template in Thrive Architect.
steps.context: open the template in Thrive Architect

steps.raw_text: Click on a **Text** element in your template (or add a new one).
steps.context: element in your template (or add a new one)

steps.raw_text: Place your cursor where you want the dynamic content to appear.
In the text editing toolbar, click the **Dynamic Text** icon (or look for the **Insert Dynamic Field** option).
steps.context: icon (or look for the Insert Dynamic Field option)

steps.raw_text: Browse the available dynamic text categories and select the tag you want to insert.
The tag will appear as a placeholder in the editor—it will display the actual personalized content on the front end.

sections.heading: Walkthrough: Adding Dynamic Text to a Lesson Template

steps.raw_text: Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice** > **Design**.
Click **Manage Templates** and find your **Lesson Template**.
Click **Edit** to open the template in Thrive Architect.
steps.context: open the template in Thrive Architect

steps.raw_text: Add a **Text** element at the top of the lesson area.
steps.context: element at the top of the lesson area

steps.raw_text: Type "Welcome back, " and then click the **Dynamic Text** icon.
Select **Student First Name** from the student information category.
Continue typing "! You've completed " and insert the **Course Progress** tag.
Finish with "% of this course."
Click **Save Work**, then click **Done** to return to Thrive Apprentice.
steps.context: then click Done to return to Thrive Apprentice
